_comment: EDGE-1 PIECE 1 (docs/HANDOFF_edge_response_queue.md §1.3/§1.6): make the ONE live
consumer reaction channel FAITHFUL by arming network.serialize_sbasis_contract, so
the emitted product carries a v2 S contract line and the replay consumer's
NetworkProductReader::makeReplayEmitter reconstructs the producer's ACTUAL per-λ
discontinuity threshold (discfrac=0.25) instead of silently falling back to the flat
kDefaultDiscThresholdM = 0.05 m.
Measured on the 12 h v1 wire (scripts/edge_reaction_correlate.py, tie-out: reproduces
SS25.2's 387 mid-arc steps > 0.1 m exactly):
fire at producer 0.25·λ  437     fire at consumer flat 0.05 m  477
producer flags / consumer MISSES    5  (all band 1; 0.25λ=0.0476 < 0.05)
consumer flags / producer did NOT  45  (all band 2; 0.25λ=0.0611 > 0.05)
So the fallback is band-asymmetric and mostly SPURIOUS, and band 2 (L2W) is the
majority reset channel (observed resets L2W 52 / L1W 31).
PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTIONS for this 3 h arm (grade against them, do not re-derive
after the fact):
P1  header is v2 and carries discfrac=0.25; replay logs 'S-contract present (v2)'.
P2  the E/C/B/P record stream is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the S-stripped control — the
knob is header-only (NetworkProductIO: 'per-epoch records unchanged; only the
header differs'), so structural byte-identity holds on the solve side.
P3  the v2 replay fires FEWER total phase-disc resets than the v1 control, the
difference being band-2/L2W-dominated (the spurious population), with a small
band-1/L1W INCREASE (the 5-per-12h miss population, so ~1 expected at 3 h).
P4  producer runtime and solve are unaffected (knob touches only the writer).
NO code change is involved: the contract already carries discfrac=
(ApplicationNetworkSetup.cpp:1062) and makeReplayEmitter already consumes it.
Denominator/posture: arm 32 (_ext63_gps_dual_3h_m15i25) verbatim — obs 15 / iono 25,
the SS26.2 unified posture — plus the single knob.  elevation_mask_deg is restated
EXPLICITLY (it is 15 in the chain root today, so this is a no-op) per the new
config-chain pairing rule: a concurrently-edited base must not re-posture this arm.
Extends _ext63_gps_dual_1h.json directly (SS23.7 depth ceiling 8).
